description: Instant buy-or-avoid verdict for a token: send a contract address (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon) or a Solana mint, get a grade A to F, a label (SAFE, CAUTION, RISKY, DANGER), a 0 to 100 score and a one-line reason, built from real checks: honeypot sell simulation, buy and sell tax, mint, freeze and owner powers, holder concentration, DEX liquidity and token age. Young or illiquid tokens can never grade above C. Also returns key facts and a share_text. Params: token (address; tokenAddress also accepted), chain (default base; solana auto-detected). Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed","chain":"base"}.

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint address. Alias: tokenAddress
